jobs.excerpt: About GruveGruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses.
jobs.description:
About Gruve

Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.

Position Summary

We are building an enterprise-scale MCP server ecosystem to connect Claude AI and other LLMs to critical business systems. The MCP Architect will design, build, and govern this integration layer — owning the full lifecycle from schema design to production deployment and will extend coverage to additional business applications as organizational needs evolve.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and own the MCP server ecosystem across Bio-Tech / Healthcare enterprise application portfolio
  • Build production-grade MCP servers in TypeScript and Python with OAuth 2.0, RBAC, and audit logging
  • Define tool schemas, versioning standards, and multi-agent orchestration patterns
  • Integrate MCP servers with SAP, Salesforce, D365, Smartsheet, Jira, Microsoft Graph API, and other business applications as per business need
  • Design the tool invocation and RBAC model for AI virtual employees and internal copilot personas
  • Align architecture with Bio-Tech / Healthcare AI Security Reference Architecture and EU AI Act compliance (Aug 2026)
  • Maintain an MCP server registry and contribute to internal Claude AI Launchpad enablement
  • Mentor AI & Automation Developers on MCP patterns and agentic integration best practices

Basic Qualifications

  • B.Tech, M.Tech, or PhD from an Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) — Mandatory, verification required at offer
  • 8+ years in software engineering with focus on API design, systems integration, or AI platform engineering
  • 3+ years hands-on building MCP servers or equivalent tool-calling frameworks (LangChain, OpenAI Function Calling)
  • Expert TypeScript and Python; strong REST/GraphQL API design and Node.js async patterns
  • Deep knowledge of MCP specification — tools, resources, prompts, sampling, and transport layers
  • Experience integrating LLMs (Claude, GPT-4) with enterprise systems in agentic or RAG architectures
  • Strong grasp of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, Azure AD, and enterprise SSO/SCIM patterns

Preferred Qualifications

  • Open-source contributions to MCP projects or the Model Context Protocol community
  • Experience with LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or Anthropic agent SDKs
  • Familiarity with Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or vector databases (Pinecone, Azure AI Search)
  • Prior experience in Life Sciences, Healthcare, or regulated enterprise environments
  • Knowledge of EU AI Act, GDPR, or ISO 27001 compliance frameworks

Why Gruve

At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

About this Role

We're looking for a Klaviyo expert Email Marketing Manager to own lifecycle marketing across Valerie's e-commerce partner brands.You'll build the customer journeys that turn first-time shoppers into loyal customers; from welcome flows and abandoned carts to post-purchase experiences, product launches, and win-back campaigns. You'll combine creativity with data to deliver campaigns that not only feel on-brand but also drive measurable business results.

You could be a great fit if...

  • You think beyond newsletters and enjoy building lifecycle journeys that improve customer experience and revenue.

  • You have deep expertise in Klaviyo and know how to use segmentation, automation, and personalisation to create high-performing campaigns.

  • You understand customer psychology and know how to build campaigns for different stages of the customer journey.

  • You're comfortable analysing performance and turning data into actionable recommendations.

  • You enjoy collaborating with designers, copywriters, and marketers to bring campaigns to life.

  • You're always looking for ways to experiment, whether that's testing new messaging, optimising send times, or exploring AI-powered workflows.

  • You take ownership of your work and enjoy building systems that scale across multiple brands.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, or email marketing, ideally within ecommerce.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Klaviyo. Experience with Omnisend, ActiveCampaign, or similar platforms is a plus.

  • A solid understanding of customer segmentation, lifecycle marketing, and conversion optimisation.

  • Experience planning and executing automated email and SMS journeys.

  • Comfortable working with GA4, Triple Whale, or similar analytics platforms to measure performance.

  • Strong project management and communication skills, with experience working across creative and marketing teams.

  • A portfolio or case studies demonstrating campaign strategy and commercial impact.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with HTML/CSS for email template customisation.

  • Experience working in a high-growth startup, agency, or ecommerce business.

  • Familiarity with AI tools for content generation, segmentation, or campaign optimisation.

  • Experience with predictive analytics, customer lifetime value modelling, or experimentation frameworks.

You probably shouldn't apply if...

  • You see email marketing as simply sending campaigns rather than building customer relationships.

  • You prefer repeating the same playbooks instead of experimenting and improving performance.

  • You're uncomfortable working with data or measuring the commercial impact of your campaigns.

  • You prefer working independently and don't enjoy collaborating with creative, product, and growth teams.

The best time to join Valerie was yesterday. The next best time is now 🤓

We'll always let you know what to expect before each stage.

💪🏾What You Can Expect

  • Meaningful work with visible impact

  • High ownership from day one

  • Collaboration with experienced founders, operators, and specialists

  • A team that values curiosity, initiative, and continuous improvement

  • Competitive compensation and the tools you need to do your best work

Valerie is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can thrive. We hire based on skills, potential, and the ability to contribute to our team.

jobs.description:
Job Title: SAP Build Developer (Low-Code/No-Code & Automation)

Location: Remote

Exp - 6 to 8 years


Job Summary: The SAP Build Developer will be responsible for creating and enhancing business applications and automating processes using the SAP Build portfolio, which includes SAP Build Apps (low-code/no-code application development), SAP Build Process Automation (workflow and RPA), and potentially SAP Build Work Zone (digital workspaces). This role requires a strong understanding of business processes, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions using SAP's low-code/no-code and intelligent automation capabilities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Application Development with SAP Build Apps:

    • Design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade custom applications using SAP Build Apps (formerly SAP AppGyver) with a focus on intuitive user interfaces and experiences.

    • Utilize drag-and-drop functionalities, pre-built components, and visual programming to create web and mobile applications.

    • Implement complex in-app business logic using triggers, decision flows, and formulas within the low-code environment.

    • Connect SAP Build Apps to various data sources, including SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP services, and external systems, via REST APIs and OData.

  • Process Automation with SAP Build Process Automation:

    • Analyze, design, and implement automated business processes and tasks using SAP Build Process Automation.

    • Develop and orchestrate workflows, create forms, and define business rules to streamline operations.

    • Leverage Robotic Process Automation (RPA) bots to automate repetitive, rule-based tasks.

    • Utilize AI capabilities within SAP Build Process Automation, such as intelligent document processing (IDP) and generative AI, for enhanced automation.

    • Integrate automated processes with SAP and non-SAP applications.

  • Collaboration & Requirements:

    • Collaborate closely with business users, functional consultants, and IT teams to gather, analyze, and translate business requirements into technical specifications for SAP Build solutions.

    • Participate in workshops, design sessions, and sprint reviews.

    • Foster a "fusion team" approach, enabling business users (citizen developers) to contribute to development efforts while ensuring governance and best practices.

  • Testing & Deployment:

    • Conduct thorough testing, including unit, integration, and user acceptance testing, to ensure the quality, functionality, and performance of developed applications and automations.

    • Support the deployment and go-live of SAP Build solutions.

    • Provide post-implementation support and troubleshooting.

  • Documentation & Best Practices:

    • Create and maintain technical documentation, including design specifications, development guides, and user manuals.

    • Adhere to SAP Build best practices, coding standards (where applicable), and security guidelines.

    • Stay updated with the latest SAP Build capabilities, releases, and industry trends.

  • Optional (SAP Build Work Zone):

    • Design and develop engaging digital workspaces and business sites using SAP Build Work Zone to provide unified access to applications, information, and collaboration tools.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Proven experience (X+ years) in developing and implementing solutions using SAP technologies.

  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP Build Apps (AppGyver) for low-code/no-code application development.

  • Solid experience with SAP Build Process Automation, including workflow design, RPA bot development, and business rules configuration.

  • Familiarity with the SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP) and its services (e.g., Integration Suite, AI Core).

  • Understanding of APIs (REST, OData) for integrating SAP Build solutions with various systems.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex business challenges into effective technical solutions.

  • Strong communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience with other low-code/no-code platforms.

  • Knowledge of traditional SAP development (ABAP, SAP Fiori, UI5) is a plus.

  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA or other SAP ECC modules.

  • Certifications in SAP Build, SAP BTP, or related areas.

  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.
